## Publish anywhere, customize safely

### `indoc publish`

```sh
indoc publish --target pages                               # GitHub Pages
indoc publish --target host                                # Netlify, Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, S3
indoc publish --target app --path /guide/ --access login   # served by your own app
```

- **GitHub Pages:** writes `.github/workflows/indoc-pages.yml` and sets `site_url`.
- **Your app:** detects the framework and prints the code to serve the docs under a path, public or login-only: Django, FastAPI, Flask, Express, NestJS, Next.js, Astro, Gin, Echo, chi, Fiber, Go. The Django, FastAPI, and Express code is tested against the real frameworks. indoc writes only its own files; app code is printed for you or your agent to add.
- `urls: files` links to `guides/setup/index.html`, which any server can serve.
- The GitHub Action gains `command: bundle`.
- With the plugin, the agent asks where the docs should live after the first build.

### Your look, kept across rebuilds

- `.indoc/theme/`: `custom.css`, `head.html`, and parts that replace the header, sidebar, landing hero, feature cards, or footer. `indoc theme eject footer` copies a built-in part to edit; a build warns when that built-in changes in a later release.
- `appearance:` gains `font`, `mono_font`, `radius`, `content_width`, and `theme` (light or dark default).
- **Hand edits to the output are no longer overwritten.** `indoc bundle` stops and lists them; `--keep-edits` moves CSS rules into `theme/custom.css` and saves other files under `theme/edited/`, `--discard-edits` overwrites.

### Fixes

- A site opened straight from disk now navigates correctly.

### Upgrading

Nothing to change. `.indoc/custom.css` and `.indoc/head.html` still work; `.indoc/theme/` is the new home for both. The first build after upgrading records file fingerprints, so hand-edit protection starts from the build after that.

Install: `curl -fsSL https://github.com/byabasaija/indoc/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh`, or update the plugin.
